name: Chip design: floorplan thermal, IR drop and electromigration, Elmore delay, lithography
description: Floorplan blocks with power densities; a 3-D die and package conduction network to the heat sink with the leakage-temperature loop; power-grid IR drop with electromigration (Black); Elmore delay of the critical nets checked by a trapezoidal transient; block placement and strap width designed and re-verified on a finer thermal model (pinneapple_design.chip.workflow); the critical layer's mask corrected and verified over the process window (litho.opc, #1180).

params.title: Chip design: floorplan thermal, IR drop and electromigration, Elmore delay, lithography
